description: Claude commits and pushes; a real click on the harness popover's Allow button (via Peekaboo) lands the push

files.hello.txt: hello from the nudge e2e harness

prompt:
Use the Bash tool to run these two commands, verbatim, as two separate Bash calls, in this order:

1. git add hello.txt && git commit -m add-hello
2. git push origin main

Do not run anything else and do not look around the repository first. If a command fails or is denied, do not retry it and do not try an alternative; stop and reply with one short line saying what happened.
